General enquiries.
Investigations in connection with the cards found
in possession of the deceased have failed to provide
information that would lead to the arrest of the
person/s responsible for the offence. These cards
which are from other members of the Labour Union,
Nantao, and also from persons connected with other
unions such as the "Tailors Society", "Bamboo Works"
Society, indication that deceased was involved in
political organisations.
Papers found in possession of deceased concern
the delivery of coal and dismissed labour, but no
addresses were written upon these papers.
Since forwarding Diary No. 2, an anonymous
letter was received at Police Headquarters stating
that the murder was committed due to internicine
trouble amongst the members of the Labour Union and
it is possible that this was the reason for the
assassination. This letter is now attached to file.
Detectives are making further enquiries in
connection with the offence and a further report will
be submitted.

在死者身上发现的文件涉及煤炭运输和被解雇的劳工，但这些文件上没有写地址。
自发送第2号日志以来，警察总局收到一封匿名信，称谋杀案是由于劳工工会成员内部的纠纷所致，这可能是暗杀的原因。此信现附于档案中。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / COMMISSIONER / SPECIAL BRANCH）

At 10 a.m. on the 18-3-41 before Procurator
Tsant Tsoeng Zu inquest was held upon deceased
at the Public Mortuary when the following decision
was rendered:-

    "Death due to gunshot wounds, Body
    to be removed by deceased wife Woo
    Van Sz for burial."

Woo Van Sz(胡樊氏) wife of deceased, residing
at No.8 Yoong Ziang Li(荣祥里) Soong Sih Ka(宋雪街)
Nantao attended the inquest having read of the
occurrence in the morning newspapers.

This female upon being interrogated stated
that her husband was a member of Labour Union in
Nantao sponsored by the Reformed Government.
Witness denied knowledge of the reason for the
Assassination, stating that to her knowledge her
husband had not been threatened by any person.

From translations in the morning dailies
(Chinese) it was observed that deceased was a
member of the Labour Union Readjustment Committee
and due to his activities in connection with this,
also the political nature of his employment, it can
be assumed that the reason for the assassination
was political.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / COMMISSIONER / SPECIAL BRANCH）

1941年3月18日上午10时，在检察官詹宗祖 (Tsant Tsoeng Zu) 面前，于公立停尸房对死者进行了死因研讯，作出如下裁定：-

    “死于枪伤，尸体由死者妻子胡樊氏
    (Woo Van Sz) 领回安葬。”

死者妻子胡樊氏 (Woo Van Sz)，居住于南市宋雪街 (Soong Sih Ka) 荣祥里 (Yoong Ziang Li) 8号，她在早报上读到此事后出席了死因研讯。

经讯问，该女子称其丈夫是维新政府支持的南市劳工工会会员。证人否认知晓暗杀原因，并称据其所知，其丈夫未受到任何人的威胁。

从中文早报的翻译中可以看出，死者是劳工工会调整委员会的成员，鉴于他与此相关的活动及其工作的政治性质，可以推断暗杀的原因是政治性的。

死者作为该委员会成员的活动

This committee are emphasized by the cards found
in his possession and further enquiries are being
made concerning these, and will be subject of a
further report.
The Finger Print Bureau representative attended
the inquest.
The Court Doctor conducted examination of the
body, recovering a second bullet from the head
slightly below the right ear, point of entry being
just above the nape of the neck. Deceased was only
struck once, the second shot fired only entering his
clothing, both bullets forwarded to the Arms
Identification Section for examination.
Investigations are proceeding.

D.S.I.

第9号。
一名华籍男子被不明身份者枪击。

page_data.en:
At 8.57 p.m. on the 17-3-41 S.P.C. 675 on
traffic duty at the Nanking Road, Yu Ya Ching
Road intersection, reported to Station by telephone,
that a male Chinese had been shot on Yu Ya Ching
Road. The Station alarm was sounded resulting
in the Officer in charge, D.S.I. Wilkinson, D.Ss.
Deaville and Rimmer, C.D.S.s 343, 161 and C.D.Cs.
88, 106 and 234 and Uniform Police attending the
scene, this party being joined by parties from
Central and Chengtu Road Stations and the Reserve
Unit.

Arrival at the scene revealed a male Chinese
shot dead, lying upon the east pavement of Yu Ya
Ching Road, twenty yards north of Nanking Road,
opposite the entrance to the Sun Company, the man
lying upon his back with head overlapping the
kerb. The Fire Brigade Ambulance was called
upon to attend and the victim removed to the
Lester Chinese Hospital, a doctor's certificate
stating:-

"Brought in dead".

Prior to the arrival of the ambulance, search
of the deceased obtained a pass, personal cards
and a chop, revealing the victim to be one named:
Woo Tsan Ling (胡兆麟) 40, native of Peiping,
residing at No. 12 Tsen Poo Ri Li (周浦西街)
Peetung,
and a badge found in his possession revealed him
to be a member of the Shanghai Labour Union, address
unknown, but believed to operate from Nantao.

Personal effects found upon deceased were as
page_data.zh:
1941年3月17日晚上8点57分，在南京路与亚尔培路 (Yu Ya Ching Road) 交叉口执行交通任务的巡捕 S.P.C. 675 通过电话向警局报告，称有一名华籍男子在亚尔培路 (Yu Ya Ching Road) 被枪击。警局发出警报，负责警官分区侦探督察威尔金森 (D.S.I. Wilkinson)、分区侦探副督察迪维尔 (D.Ss. Deaville) 和里默 (Rimmer)、华籍侦探警士 343、161 号及华籍侦探巡捕 88、106 和 234 号以及制服警员赶赴现场，中央警局和成都路警局的警员以及后备队也加入了该队伍。

抵达现场后发现，一名华籍男子中弹身亡，躺在亚尔培路 (Yu Ya Ching Road) 东侧人行道上，位于南京路以北二十码处，正对先施公司 (Sun Company) 入口，该男子仰面躺着，头部越出路缘石。消防队救护车奉召前往，受害者被送往莱斯特华人医院，医生证明书写道：-

“送医时已死亡”。

在救护车到达之前，对死者的搜查获得了一张通行证、个人名片和一枚印章，显示受害者名为：胡兆麟 (Woo Tsan Ling)，40岁，北平人，居住在浦东周浦西街 (Tsen Poo Ri Li) 12号，在他身上发现的一枚徽章显示他是上海劳工工会会员，地址不详，但据信在南市活动。

死者身上的私人物品如下

page_data.en:
1/3.

follows:-
1 wallet containing cards, various papers,
1 Post dated cheque for $300.00( signed by
the victim), $4.35 in cash and one fountain pen.

Investigations in the vicinity failed to locate
any witnesses to the offence and it was not ascer-
tained if deceased was in company with friends at
the time of the shooting.

Search of the vicinity failed to locate likely
suspects and no empty cartridge cases were located,
this being later accounted for after a visit to the
hospital, a .32 Calibre Revolver bullet being found
in the clothing of deceased, who also appeared to
have been shot twice in the back of the head.

S.P.C. 675 who reported the occurrence was
interrogated, and he stated that he had heard the
sound of two shots being fired but had failed to
observe any person running from the scene. This
officer had proceeded to the place of shooting and,
after observing the victim had made report to this
Station.

C.P.C. 2987 on traffic duty at the Nanking Road,
Yu Ya Ching Road intersection was also interrogated,
but this officer had failed to hear the shots or
observe likely suspects.
page_data.zh:
1/3.

所示：-
1个钱包，内含名片、各种文件、
一张由受害者签署的$300.00远期支票、现金$4.35和一支钢笔。

在附近的调查未能找到任何目击者，也无法确定枪击发生时死者是否与朋友在一起。

对附近的搜查未能找到可疑嫌疑人，也未发现空弹壳，这一点在随后访问医院后得到了解释，在死者衣物中发现了一枚.32口径左轮手枪子弹，死者后脑似乎中了两次枪击。

报告此案的 S.P.C. 675 接受了讯问，他表示听到了两声枪响，但未观察到有人从现场逃跑。这名警官前往枪击地点，在观察受害者后向本局作了报告。

在南京路与亚尔培路 (Yu Ya Ching Road) 交叉口执行交通任务的 C.P.C. 2987 也接受了讯问，但该警官未听到枪声或观察到可疑嫌疑人。

page_data.en:
1/40

Due to the absence of witnesses and information
concerning the offence, the motive is at present
obscure. Further enquiries are being made which
might clarify this point, these being based upon
papers found upon deceased, including various cards
and telephone numbers. A further diary will be
submitted regarding these investigations.

The body of deceased was removed to the Public
Mortuary pending inquest on the 18-3-41, when a
request will be made for other bullets still in
the body. The bullet recovered will be forwarded
to the Arms Identification Section for examination.

The "Hung Plan" system was operated upon
initial report, being cancelled at 10.30 p.m.

Message was circulated regarding the occurrence.
All senior officers were informed.
Investigations are proceeding.

D.D.C.O. "A".

由于缺乏目击者和关于此案的信息，动机目前尚不明确。正在进行进一步调查以澄清这一点，这些调查基于在死者身上发现的文件，包括各种名片和电话号码。将提交一份关于这些调查的后续日志。

死者遗体已被移送至公立停尸房，等待1941年3月18日的死因研讯，届时将要求取出体内剩余的其他子弹。取出的子弹将送交枪械鉴定科进行检查。

在初步报告时启动了“洪计划” (Hung Plan) 系统，并于晚上10点30分取消。
